findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_business_presentations, get_market_status, get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_published_intelligence_catalog, get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: quote_matching_rfps, get_business_presentation, get_published_intelligence_sample, create_checkout, get_machine_payment_options, get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_business_presentations, get_market_status, get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_published_intelligence_catalog, get_published_intelligence_sample, get_free_data_sample, create_checkout, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: quote_matching_rfps, get_business_presentation, get_published_intelligence_sample, create_checkout, get_machine_payment_options, get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
